_about: C16b golden, written before any product run. value + formula per item. Round positions P1 (newest) .. P31 (oldest); ids in round_ids.json; P25 = merged same-day cards P25a+P25b.

handicapEstimate.formula: WHS: differential=(score-71.0)*113/113; most recent 20 priceable records (unpriceable P2,P4,P5,P9,P11,P17 skipped) lowest 7 of 19 [10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0] -> 70.0/7; ambiguity-proof: reading 'latest 20 rounds minus unpriceable' = 14 diffs -> lowest 4 [10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 10.0] -> same

handicapBefore20.formula: estimate on rounds older than the latest 20 (P21..P31): lowest 1 of 5 [14.0] -> 14.0/1 (every older priceable diff is 14.0 -> any WHS sample rule gives 14.0)

careerAverage18.formula: all 18-hole rounds (27, incl. merged P25) sum 2289 / 27 -- must differ from recent10Average (生涯不冒充近期)

bestScore.formula: min 18-hole score; best overall = P2 78, which is also the best of the last 10 (ambiguity-proof for '近 10 场 ... 最佳')

totalRounds.formula: 31 rounds (32 cards, P25a+P25b merge into one)

courseCount.formula: Kestrel Hills, Lark Valley, Pine Field

line10.formula: info for C16e (drawn client-side): mean of each point and the up-to-9 18-hole rounds before it; last value must equal recent10Average

recentThree.formula: archive newest first P1,P2,P3; strip = per-hole strokes-par in hole order

last10Months.formula: 范围定样本: months of P1..P10 only (not 12 months)

last20.formula: prev20 = P21,P22,P23,P24,P25,P26,P27,P28,P29,P30,P31 (11 rounds); short of 20 -> no comparison

all.formula: [B5a] 全部不比较: no previous block

hardestHoleVisits.formula: every round/display hole that played gid:7201:1-9 hole 8

hasShots.formula: rounds with a shot file: P1,P3,P7,P12

larkNoShots.formula: Lark Valley x no shots: P8,P11,P14,P17,P22,P26,P29

monthGroups2026.formula: year=2026 grouped by month, newest month first, rounds newest first inside

puttEligibleHoles.formula: 522 holes - 4 unedited default ['P2#6', 'P2#14', 'P9#3', 'P9#6'] = 518 (corrected default holes stay in: ['P2#12=1', 'P4#5=3'])

girEligibleHoles.formula: same denominator rule as putting: all holes minus unedited default holes

penaltyHolesRecorded.formula: P2:15 + P4:18 + P5:18 + P9:16 = 67 (Garmin holes carry no penalties field -> not recorded, not 0)

composition.formula: count of (strokes-par) over 522 holes: <=-2 eagle, -1 birdie, 0 par, 1 bogey, 2 double, 3 triple, >=4 quadPlus

byPar.formula: per par: holeCount, sum strokes / holeCount -> averageScore (1 dp), parOrBetter = strokes<=par (保帕)

valued.formula: P1#1: strokes 4 par 4 raw putts 2 default=False corrected=False -> putts 2, GIR (4-2<=2)

garminNoPutts.formula: P28#1: strokes 5 par 4 raw putts None default=False corrected=False -> putts None, GIR unknown

defaultUnedited.formula: P2#6: strokes 3 par 3 raw putts 2 default=True corrected=False -> putts None, GIR unknown

defaultCorrected.formula: P2#12: strokes 3 par 3 raw putts 2 default=True corrected=True -> putts 1, GIR (3-1<=1)

normalCorrected.formula: P4#5: strokes 5 par 4 raw putts 2 default=False corrected=True -> putts 3, GIR (5-3<=2)

manualPenaltyZero.formula: P2#1: strokes 4 par 4 raw putts 2 default=False corrected=False -> putts 2, GIR (4-2<=2)

manualPenaltyOne.formula: P4#8: strokes 6 par 4 raw putts 2 default=False corrected=False -> putts 2, GIR (6-2<=2)

garminNoPenaltyField.formula: P1#8: strokes 6 par 4 raw putts 2 default=False corrected=False -> putts 2, GIR (6-2<=2)

loops.formula: [B0d1] key = gid:<id>:<span> (no id -> course:<courseKey>:<span>); per loop hole mean(strokes-par) over every time it was played, 2 dp

nineCombos.formula: [B0d1] holesCompleted==18 rounds grouped front loop -> back loop (A/B != B/A); rows with >1 round have distinct counts

kestrelComboCount.formula: 全部 N 种组合 at Kestrel

kestrelTopThreeCombos.formula: 常打三种: highest round counts 8,5,3 (no ties)

hardestHoles.formula: [B0d1] loop holes with >=2 samples, by averageToPar desc, top 5; boundary and order tie-free

kestrelHardestThree.formula: [SPEC 2.6] course page: that course's own loop holes, >=2 samples, top 3 (selection drawn client-side; info for C16e)

clubs.formula: [GUIDE] Driver(clubId101)+driver(clubId102) merge case-insensitively into one club of 11; clubId 0 (Unknown, 3 shots) dropped; 3W has 1 sample (low sample)

unknownShots.formula: clubId 0 shots, excluded from every club row

bagGarmin.formula: [MANUAL] no manual bag -> the synced Garmin bag; PW advice 0 = no distance (empty, not 0)

bagNone.formula: a player with neither manual nor synced bag -> empty

bagManual.formula: PUT manual bag [driver (no distance), iron7 150 m, pw (no distance)] -> manual wins over Garmin

ladderAfterManual.formula: [course_prep.effective_club_ladder contract] manual distance > own measured median > catalog: driver median 220.0 (11 merged shots), iron7 typed 150 (measured 148.0 ignored), pw median 105.0; sorted longest first

P12.formula: Garmin B/A composite: card 1 = loop B holes 1-9 (id 7102), card 2 = loop A holes 1-9 (id 7101); GIR by putts strokes-putts<=par-2; penalty total only from holes that carry penalties

P3.formula: Lark single 18: holes 10-18 are holes 10-18 of the same id 7201; GIR by putts strokes-putts<=par-2; penalty total only from holes that carry penalties

P25.formula: two same-day 9-hole cards A then C merged: 10-18 are loop C holes 1-9 (id 7103); GIR by putts strokes-putts<=par-2; penalty total only from holes that carry penalties

P22.formula: 9-hole round on Lark back nine: one card, holes 10-18 of id 7201; GIR by putts strokes-putts<=par-2; penalty total only from holes that carry penalties

P28.formula: Garmin round without putts: GIR/putting unknown (missing, not 0); GIR by putts strokes-putts<=par-2; penalty total only from holes that carry penalties

P5.formula: manual round, no Garmin id: penalties recorded (1), no fairway; GIR by putts strokes-putts<=par-2; penalty total only from holes that carry penalties

P1h4.formula: P1 #4 (A par 5, 6 strokes, 2 putts): 4 shots driver/7I/PW/PW, ends Fairway/Rough/Rough/Green; 推 x2

P7h1.formula: P7 #1: Driver, 7I, then a clubId-0 shot (no club label, not 'Unknown'); 推 x2

P12h12.formula: P12 #12 (A#3 par 3): one PW shot to Green, 推 x2

average18.formula: all 18-hole rounds (27, incl. merged P25) sum 2289 / 27 -- must differ from recent10Average (生涯不冒充近期)

bestScore.formula: min 18-hole score; best overall = P2 78, which is also the best of the last 10 (ambiguity-proof for '近 10 场 ... 最佳')

noShotRound.formula: P2 has no shot file -> the report must not cite shots for it
